title: PowerToys Systray: Left-click menu opens stretched over the screen

judgment.rationale: The report identifies the first left-click after restart, a 5120x1440 display, and a normal-sized second-click result; a maintainer hypothesized FancyZones may treat the flyout as a normal window, and the author confirmed reproduction on 0.79.0. The next action is to test the same path on current builds and isolate FancyZones.
evidence: The issue reports PowerToys 0.75.1 on Windows 10 22H2 with a 5120x1440 ultra-wide monitor; a Surface Pro display did not show the issue.
The first tray left-click opens an unmovable, oversized window; the second click opens the menu normally.
A maintainer suggested FancyZones may be placing the flyout as a normal window: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/29718#issuecomment-1971281979.
The author confirmed the issue remained reproducible on 0.79.0: https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/issues/29718#issuecomment-1978986762.
judgment.recommended_action: Reproduce first-click behavior on an ultra-wide display with FancyZones enabled and disabled, and inspect flyout placement/size state.

fix_assessment.rationale: The maintainer’s placement hypothesis and first-click-specific symptom make an exclusion/initial-size issue plausible, but no linked fix or current-build reproduction establishes it.

proposed_fixes.title: Keep the tray flyout out of normal FancyZones placement
proposed_fixes.root_cause: Hypothesis: on the first click after startup, the PowerToys tray flyout may be treated as a normal top-level window by FancyZones or use an uninitialized placement/size. The later normal open and display-specific report do not prove which layer is responsible.
plan: Compare the first and second tray clicks after a clean PowerToys restart on a 5120x1440 display, with FancyZones enabled and then disabled.
Inspect the flyout's first-show bounds, owner/activation state, and FancyZones exclusion classification.

If FancyZones is positioning the flyout, mark it as a transient flyout and ensure it is excluded from normal zone placement; if initial bounds are wrong without FancyZones, correct first-show sizing instead.
Add a startup/first-show regression test and verify normal behavior at both ultra-wide and standard resolutions.
verification: After restarting PowerToys, the first left-click opens a correctly sized, movable flyout.
The second click behaves consistently with the first.
Repeat at 5120x1440 and a standard display resolution, with FancyZones enabled and disabled.

confidence.rationale: The first-click sequence, display specificity, 0.79.0 confirmation, and maintainer placement hypothesis support a testable direction, but no source proof or current-build validation is available.

issue_context.summary: The first left-click on the PowerToys tray icon after restart opens an oversized, unmovable window on an ultra-wide display; the second click works normally.
known_information: The original report lists Windows 10 22H2 and PowerToys 0.75.1; the primary monitor resolution is 5120x1440.
The issue did not appear on the author's Surface Pro 7 native display.
A maintainer suggested FancyZones might treat the flyout as a normal window.
The author confirmed the problem on 0.79.0; there is no later current-version confirmation.
inferences: A first-show bounds/initialization or FancyZones placement interaction is plausible.
Because the second click opens normally, a persistent global layout error is less likely, but not ruled out.
issue_context.analysis: A controlled current-build comparison with FancyZones toggled is the discriminating test. A targeted fix design should follow only after determining whether the bad bounds originate in flyout initialization or zoning.
initial_investigation: Read the full issue body, all comments, and linked screenshots from their issue references.
Reviewed the current PowerToys tray flyout ownership path; the observed first-click behavior does not establish a specific bounds or placement root cause.

reproduce.version_requirement: Use a current supported PowerToys build; historical confirmation was on 0.79.0.
prerequisites: A 5120x1440 or similarly ultra-wide display, if available.
steps: Restart PowerToys and left-click its tray icon once; record the flyout size, position, and whether it can be moved.
Close the flyout and click the tray icon a second time; compare its bounds and interaction.
Repeat with FancyZones disabled and compare the first click.
If available, repeat on a standard-resolution display.
reproduce.expected: The first and later clicks show the same normal, usable flyout without spanning most of the display.

actions.label: Approve flyout placement investigation
actions.note: The yellow placement hypothesis must be confirmed by current-build reproduction.
